dohaDesc:
Shriguru's feet are Saroj Raj, my heart is Mukuru and I will describe the pure glory of Raghubar, who gives four fruits

Knowing that my body is devoid of wisdom, I pray to Pawan-kumar (Lord Hanuman).

Give me strength, wisdom and knowledge, remove my pain and suffering.
chalisa:
Victory to you, O Hanuman! Ocean of knowledge and virtues,
Victory to the chief of monkeys, who is famous across all three worlds!

You are the messenger of Rama, an abode of incomparable strength,
You are Anjani’s son, and known as the Wind God's child.

Mighty hero, strong as a thunderbolt,
Remover of evil thoughts, companion of good wisdom.

Golden-colored and beautifully dressed,
Wearing earrings, with curly hair.

Holding a thunderbolt and a flag in your hands,
A sacred thread made of munja grass adorns your shoulder.

You are the incarnation of Lord Shiva, son of Kesari,
Your glory and splendor are revered throughout the world.

Full of knowledge, virtue, and extremely clever,
You are always eager to serve Lord Rama.

You delight in listening to the Lord's story,
And you reside in the hearts of Rama, Lakshman, and Sita.

In your subtle form, you showed yourself to Sita,
In a terrifying form, you set Lanka ablaze.

Assuming a monstrous form, you destroyed demons,
You fulfilled Lord Rama’s mission.

You brought the Sanjeevani to revive Lakshman,
Lord Rama embraced you joyfully.

Rama praised you highly,
He said, "You are as dear to me as my brother Bharat."

Thousands of mouths sing your glory,
And so said Lord Vishnu, as He embraced you.

Saints like Sanaka, Brahma, Narad, Saraswati, and the serpent god,
Even Yama, Kubera, and the guardians of the directions — all fail to describe your greatness.

You helped Sugriva,
Introduced him to Rama and helped him regain his kingdom.

Vibhishan followed your advice,
He became king of Lanka — the whole world knows this.

You swallowed the sun from thousands of yojanas away,
Thinking it to be a sweet fruit.

With Rama’s ring in your mouth,
You leapt over the ocean — it was no surprise.

All the difficult tasks in the world
Become easy with your grace.

You are the guardian of Lord Rama’s door,
No one can enter without your permission.

All happiness comes from taking shelter in you,
Those under your protection need not fear anything.

You alone can control your immense power,
All the three worlds tremble at your roar.

Evil spirits and ghosts do not come near
When they hear the name of Mahaveer Hanuman.

All ailments and pain are destroyed,
When your name is chanted continuously.

Hanuman frees one from troubles
For those who meditate on you with mind, words, and actions.

Lord Rama is the ascetic king of all,
And you accomplish all His works.

Whoever brings their wishes to you
Receives immeasurable rewards in life.

Your glory spans the four ages (yugas),
You are famous throughout the universe.

You protect sages and saints,
You destroy demons, and are dear to Lord Rama.

You are the giver of the eight siddhis and nine treasures,
This boon was given to you by Mother Sita.

You hold the elixir of devotion to Rama,
You forever remain His faithful servant.

Through your devotion, one can attain Rama,
And forget all sufferings of countless lifetimes.

At life’s end, one goes to Rama’s abode
And takes rebirth as His devoted follower.

Other deities may not come to mind,
But devotion to Hanuman brings all joy.

All problems and pains are removed
For those who remember Hanuman, the brave hero.

Victory, victory, victory to you, O Lord Hanuman!
Please bless me like a true Guru would.

Whoever recites this a hundred times
Will be freed from bondage and attain great happiness.

One who reads this Hanuman Chalisa
Will achieve success, as testified by Lord Shiva.

Tulsidas, the eternal servant of Lord Hari,
Prays for the Lord to dwell in his heart.
